A.name: Ground truth provenance
A.details: ScanRefer annotations identify the target and ScanNet object members/bounding boxes provide GT. Root boxes and GT masks are dataset labels, not predicted-mask or refined-box pseudo-labels. Predicted Mask summaries are input features only. Native language token maps come from text parsing; the model input excludes GT boxes/masks, and filter_non_gt_boxes=False. B.name: Denominators and normalization
B.details: Box IoU is intersection/union; strict >0.25 and >0.50 decisions use all evaluated rows. Mask mIoU is sum of saved per-row native Mask IoU divided by 6887 or 9508. DFL is mean over every native matched box times six faces, then separately weighted by 1/7. Softmax, input point-range scaling, predicted-mask member weighting, and coarse-size-normalized offset targets are internal features/losses, not reported accuracy normalization. No prediction maximum/mean denominator inflates the reported metrics.
